mapper.sql: id , function_type, function_type_name, sub_function_type, sub_function_type_name, function_code, function_code_name, function_detail, icon_code, icon_url, icon_colour, create_date, update_date, url, delete_flag, status, des_image_url, des_video_url, function_label
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT f.id,f.function_type,f.function_type_name,f.sub_function_type,f.sub_function_type_name,f.function_code, f.function_code_name,f.function_detail,f.icon_code,f.icon_colour,f.url,f.des_image_url,f.des_video_url FROM vm_function_type f left join vm_algorithm_info_t fa ON fa.function_code = f.function_code LEFT JOIN vm_order_algorithms oa ON oa.algorithm_code = fa.algorithm_code WHERE f.id = #{id}
